interpretation: This is the type-restricted, nonempty antecedent reading of the displayed aggregation commitment. It is not silently replaced by unrestricted fusion for every arbitrary set or by a single greatest entity. No assertion about substantial unity, composition-as-identity or a cause follows. Attribution is to McIntosh’s presentation only, not the unread Koons1997 or Hawthorne–Cortens1993 works referenced on p24. No formal result or premise truth is established.
